subject.title: [Bug] "Cannot convert undefined or null to object" in 2026.3.2 with google-vertex/gemini-3.1-pro-preview

question: For native Google Vertex ADC, should OpenClaw use a provider-owned auth transport/custom fetch path, change the global `node-domexception` override, or land only the sanitizer slice and keep the ADC crash separate?
rationale: The remaining failure path handles Google credentials and dependency transport behavior, so automation should not choose the permanent auth/dependency boundary without maintainer intent and live proof.

options.title: Use provider-owned auth transport
options.body: Mirror the scoped Google Chat-style transport or equivalent provider-owned fetch path for Vertex ADC, then require live service-account or external_account proof before closing this issue.

options.title: Change the global dependency override
options.body: Remove or replace the `node-domexception` nolyfill override, accepting a wider packaging and dependency validation surface.

options.title: Land sanitizer only
options.body: Merge the narrow thinking-payload sanitizer PR while keeping this issue open for the service-account/external_account ADC crash path.

recommendation.title: Use provider-owned auth transport
recommendation.body: Mirror the scoped Google Chat-style transport or equivalent provider-owned fetch path for Vertex ADC, then require live service-account or external_account proof before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to both the shared SDK stream-wrapper path and Vertex ADC fixes, making them the best available owner for the auth/dependency boundary choice.
